items.text: Supreme Court upholds states' ability to count mail ballots received after Election Day if postmarked by Election Day, defeating Trump-aligned challenge
Supreme Court agrees to hear Arizona's proof-of-citizenship voter registration law, a case affecting 43,000+ registered voters
Connecticut's no-excuse absentee voting law takes effect July 1, fulfilling a voter-approved constitutional amendment
New Jersey becomes first state to enact voting rights reform in direct response to the Supreme Court's Louisiana v. Callais ruling
Delaware AG wins two federal court victories striking down Trump executive orders on proof-of-citizenship voter registration and a new election-enforcement commission
